title: Weekly content sprint
when: Every week once the plan is set.
summary: Check last week, pick ideas, hooks, scripts, packaging, clean-up, adapt for spokes, schedule, publish, engage, log.

steps.title: Read last week
steps.do: If you have numbers, read the outliers and the cliffs. Name one thing to repeat and one to drop.

steps.title: Pick this week's ideas
steps.do: Choose ideas for each hub slot. Balance the pillars.

steps.title: Hooks
steps.do: Three scored hooks each. Keep the best.

steps.title: Scripts or copy
steps.do: Video: script and time it. Carousel: sr-carousel. Text: sr-text-post.

steps.title: Titles, captions, keywords
steps.do: YouTube: title and thumbnail as a pair. Everywhere else: caption with the preview window checked.

steps.title: Humanize and policy check
steps.do: Clean the copy. Check originality, disclosure and claims.

steps.title: Edit plan
steps.do: Cut list, caption file, b-roll notes. Apply it in your editor.

steps.title: Adapt for spokes
steps.do: Native version for each spoke: new first frame, platform captions, no foreign watermarks.

steps.title: Update the calendar
steps.do: Move anything that slipped. Keep the plan inside your hours.

steps.title: Engage for 48 hours
steps.do: Reply to every comment worth answering. Comment on ten accounts in your niche.

steps.title: Log it
steps.do: Record the numbers and the variable you changed.
